svg.title: FloorSync — Event-Sourced Playback

text.tspan: Persisted control history → authoritative server position → local browser animation
Authoritative read path · replay the saved log at server time
Apply speed, pause, seek and reset
Derived at the server read time
Paused intervals add no simulated time.
Seek sets position; reset rewinds to zero.
Browser time is never the stored authority.
